mapper.select: SELECT u.id, u.username, u.email, u.avatar, u.bio, u.status, u.last_active_at, u.created_at, COALESCE((SELECT COUNT(1) FROM t_note_item n WHERE n.user_id = u.id AND n.is_deleted = 0 AND n.is_public = 1), 0) AS noteCount, COALESCE((SELECT COUNT(1) FROM t_user_follow uf WHERE uf.following_id = u.id), 0) AS followerCount, (SELECT COUNT(1) FROM t_main_link m WHERE m.user_id = u.id) > 0 AS hasMainLink FROM t_user_follow f INNER JOIN t_user u ON f.following_id = u.id WHERE f.follower_id = #{followerId} AND u.status != 0 ORDER BY f.created_at DESC
